get.description: Labels for MITRE ATT&CK technique ids from the pinned offline index, with its notice.

post.description: What a run with this body would send (pseudonyms shown). Nothing is persisted.

get.description: The AI provider catalog with this org's configuration status (never a key).

put.description:
Store a key (sealed, write-only), enable/disable, acknowledge the terms (and, for
Gemini, the paid tier), pick a model. A new key is checked after the commit
(`ai.verify`) within the per-provider verify limit; `verify_queued` says whether it was.

post.description: Queue a check of the stored key (the analyst worker calls the provider).

get.description: Top-level runs, newest first (incident digests are listed in their parent).

post.description:
Freeze the context and queue an analysis (an incident also queues one digest per
job). An identical active or completed run is returned instead (200), unless
`regenerate`.

get.description:
The run with its output read model when completed: claim statuses, resolved
citations (deep links for verified ones only) and pseudonyms. Reversing them to the
original internal values needs `evidence.write` (the default for analysts and up unless
`keep`); viewers always get them kept as sent (403 on an explicit `reverse`).

The exact frozen context(s) sent; `reveal=true` adds the pseudonym map (audited;
`evidence.write` only, 403 for viewers).
The org's AI settings (the defaults until saved), the ceilings and the privacy notice.

put.description:
Partial update. Turning AI on, or widening what is sent later, needs
`acknowledge_privacy`; budgets stay within the operator ceilings.

get.description: Today's (UTC) tokens and estimated cost per provider, against the budget.

`namespace`: that capa namespace or below; `attack`: an ATT&CK technique id (its
sub-techniques included) or sub-technique id.

post.description: Enrich a succeeded analysis job's IOC set (sample hashes first, then by count).

get.description: `library`: case-insensitive exact DLL name; `q`: substring of function or library.

Versioned JSON report of a succeeded static analysis (an audited download; the
evidence custody chain is unchanged: the evidence bytes are not read).

409.description: Not a static analysis, or it has not succeeded.

get.description: AI outputs (verified citations) and report versions that cite one row.

post.description: Queue an analyzer run over the evidence (re-runs keep earlier jobs as history).

get.description: The evidence's "do not send to AI / TI" flags and its effective policy.

put.description:
Set the flags (turning one off needs `integrations.manage`); audited
`evidence.share_policy_updated`. The evidence row itself is never touched.

get.description: The provider catalog with this org's configuration status (never a key).

put.description:
Store a key (sealed, write-only), enable/disable, acknowledge terms, set limits or the
MISP base URL. A new key is checked after the commit (`ti.verify`) within the same
per-provider limit as POST .../verify; `verify_queued` says whether it was.

post.description: Queue a check of the stored key (the enrich worker calls the provider).

get.description: Mappings with labels, and the tactic-grouped matrix (v20 order, rejected excluded).

post.description:
`422 invalid_technique` (unknown, revoked or deprecated), `409 mapping_exists`,
`422 ref_out_of_scope`; audited `case_attack.mapped`.

get.description: From capa, findings and verified AI techniques of the case; never auto-confirmed.

post.description: Raw request body = the evidence bytes (streamed, hashed, stored; never parsed).
`409 collection_exists` for a duplicate name in the case.

get.description: IOCs of the latest succeeded job per evidence, deduplicated (`case_iocs.case_iocs`).

The current version of each note; deleted notes only with `include_deleted`
(tombstones without body).

post.description:
Refs are re-checked in the org and case scope (`422 ref_out_of_scope`); audited
`note.created` (ids and ref count, never the body).

TLP defaults to the case TLP; below it needs `org.update` + the acknowledgement;
`409 investigation_archived`.

get.description: Status history of the case, newest first (M6 phase 2; 501 until then).

Merged case timeline: custody, job lifecycle, the latest pcap job's timeline and alerts
per evidence, and static findings at analysis time; sorted (ts, kind, ref_id). M6: case
events (notes, status changes) have no `evidence_id`; `kinds` filters by ref kind.

A streamed, TLP-headed, formula-safe attachment of at most TIMELINE_EXPORT_MAX_ROWS
entries (nosniff, no-store, CSP sandbox); audited `investigation.timeline_exported`.

A streamed attachment (RFC 5987 filename, nosniff, no-store, CSP sandbox); never
redacted; `defang=false` needs `evidence.write`; audited `ioc_collection.exported`.
Each item with its attributed TI summary (latest per provider) and source job.

post.description: Up to 500 per call; per item `added | duplicate | invalid(reason)`.

delete.description: Soft delete (the versions stay); author or `org.update` only.

get.description: The current version and the full version history.

put.description: Author or `org.update` only; `409 stale_note` on a wrong `expected_version`.

get.description:
Streamed from the exact object version, re-hashed while streaming (`409
integrity_failed`); attachment with the TLP in the filename, nosniff, no-store, CSP
sandbox; audited `report.downloaded`.
The org-wide list (latest version, TLP, updated).

post.description:
Freeze the draft into a signed version (PDF render queued): `422 report_too_large`,
`422 report_too_large_to_render` (RT1), `409 tlp_below_case` (RT7),
`422 external_review_required` (RT8), `422 distribution_required`, `409 stale_draft`.

The snapshot built in memory with its size and render units against the budget;
nothing stored, nothing audited.

get.description: Manifest, `signature_valid`, `snapshot_ok` (re-hashed), counts, renders.

The stored snapshot for the viewer (inline, `no-store`), re-hashed (`409
integrity_failed`); not audited per view (RT11).
`{manifest, signature, kid, alg}` served as `.sig.json`.

The canonical JSON exactly as stored, as an attachment; audited
`report.snapshot_downloaded`.

post.description:
Manual IOC lookup: a per-value normalization report plus the run (if any value is
eligible for a requested provider).

get.description:
Every stored answer for the normalized indicator, newest first (400 `invalid_ioc`
when the value cannot be normalized; `skipped` says why no provider would receive it).

The run with one page of its items, each with its result (`from_cache` when the
answer came from an earlier run).
